# Leslie Moore

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-eight  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c10 P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)</sub>
- **Origin:** Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c11 P4](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0004), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Former schoolteacher; keeps summer boarders  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Leslie  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Leslie is an exceptionally beautiful young woman with sea-blue eyes, slender brown hands, and a graceful figure. She possesses striking golden hair that falls in a rich fountain to her feet and shines like molten gold. She frequently wears a plain cream-tinted dress paired with a girdle or scarf of crimson, as she never feels satisfied without a gleam of red about her.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P17](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0017), [v4 c10 P28](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0028), [v4 c12 P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 c21 P17](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0017), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c26 P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 c33 P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001)_

## Personality

Clever, proud, and fiercely resolute, Leslie possesses a glowing personality that was long pent up beneath a cold and reserved exterior. She holds a strong, unyielding sense of duty and refuses to be pitied by others despite her hardships. When among trusted friends, her warmth, keen wit, and spirited nature break through her former bitterness.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c23 P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024), [v4 c23 P33](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0033), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c30 P27](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0027), [v4 c31 P0](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0000)_

## History

Leslie grew up in Four Winds as the adored daughter of Frank West. After witnessing her brother's tragic death and discovering her father's suicide, she resolved to work her way through Queen's Academy and teach. At sixteen, she was coerced into marrying Dick Moore to prevent her mother's home from being mortgaged away. Shortly after her mother's death, Dick went off to sea, only to be brought back years later as an invalid with no memory or intellect. Leslie spent eleven long years loyally nursing him at her old family farm while living in extreme poverty and isolation. Her life changed after befriending Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe, whose circle introduced her to new hope and joy. Encouraged by Gilbert to seek medical help, Leslie took Dick to Montreal for surgery, where it was discovered that the man was actually Dick's cousin, George Moore, leaving Leslie legally free. She later fell in love with writer Owen Ford and accepted his proposal in Anne's garden.

_Sources: [v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016), [v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020), [v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 c17 P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 c25 P15](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0015), [v4 c30 P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c38 P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Frank West and Rose Elliott  <sub>[v4 c11 P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015)</sub>
- Lost her younger brother Kenneth in a farm accident at age twelve  <sub>[v4 c11 P16](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0016)</sub>
- Found her father after he committed suicide when she was fourteen  <sub>[v4 c11 P20](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0020)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy on an inheritance from her Grandmother West and taught at Glen school  <sub>[v4 c11 P22](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0022)</sub>
- Coerced into marrying Dick Moore at sixteen to save her mother from foreclosure  <sub>[v4 c10 P49](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0049), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>
- Lost her mother to pneumonia the spring following her marriage  <sub>[v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- Spent eleven years caring for an injured, brain-damaged man believed to be Dick Moore  <sub>[v4 c11 P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035)</sub>

## Quotes

> If we are to be friends you must call me Leslie,  <sub>[v4 c10 P29](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0029)</sub>

> I ENVY Anne, and I’d envy her even if she had died! She was a mother for one beautiful day. I’d gladly give my life for THAT!  <sub>[v4 c19 P28](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0028)</sub>

> Anne, you don’t know how GOOD it is to be sitting here with you again—working—and talking—and being silent together.  <sub>[v4 c21 P0](../source/v04-c21.md#nw-v04-c21-p0000)</sub>

> There is no cage, but—it doesn’t seem as if there were anything else, Anne.  <sub>[v4 c33 P14](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0014)</sub>

> I hated my beauty because it had attracted him, but now—oh, I’m glad that I have it. It’s all I have to offer Owen,—his artist soul delights in it.  <sub>[v4 c38 P33](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0033)</sub>
